_comment: Cursor MCP configuration. Project scope: .cursor/mcp.json in your repo (committable). Global scope: ~/.cursor/mcp.json in your home directory. Top-level key is 'mcpServers'. Cursor interpolates ${env:NAME}, ${userHome}, ${workspaceFolder}, ${workspaceFolderBasename} and ${pathSeparator} inside command, args, env, url and headers. Replace every path with an absolute one.

catalogue-http._comment: The same server over the Streamable HTTP transport. Requires the server to be running separately (MCP_TRANSPORT=http MCP_AUTH_TOKEN=... node dist/typescript/src/index.js). Cursor sends the headers on every request; ${env:MCP_AUTH_TOKEN} keeps the token out of this file.
